runs.summary: Only one 1BR fully cleared the stricter live-verification bar today: Beatrice in Chelsea/NoMad. Track B had no shortlist survivor once I enforced direct opened-page proof plus unresolved dishwasher/A-C caveats, and Track C had no true 3BR/3BA Manhattan core fit under budget that survived current-page verification.
runs.notes: Deep live sweep on 2026-05-17 using opened-page verification across direct operator sites and portals. Shortlist kept intentionally small; conditional rows moved to monitor or excluded.
sourcesSearched: Google-style web discovery across Chelsea, West Village, East Village, Greenwich Village, Flatiron, and Tribeca
blindSpots: StreetEasy numeric rental pages repeatedly cache-missed after discovery, so some neighborhood-page leads could not be opened to unit detail pages.
Some operator sites exposed building or floor-plan inventory but not full unit-level appliance detail, which pushed otherwise promising rows into monitor.
Apartments.com exact-unit links sometimes redirected to generic city search pages instead of the intended listing.
StuyTown unit pages rendered incomplete or placeholder-like detail and did not provide reliable live price verification in this session.

listings.name: Beatrice Apartments 1BR (1 Bedroom I.2, floor 28)
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened Equity availability page: 1 Bedroom I.2 on floor 28 at $5,831 for 643 sq ft, available 5/17/2026.

commute.route: R/W from 28 St to Prince or roughly a mid-20s walk
commute.notes: Easy one-line commute to 1 Example Plaza with strong walking fallback.

amenities: Central heat and AC in all rooms
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Direct Equity page lists in-home washer and dryer, dishwasher, floor-to-ceiling windows, and central heat and AC; the specific row also showed 643 sq ft, photos, and a 3D floorplan.
listings.furnitureFit: Strongest 1BR fit of the run. The 643 sq ft plan with full 1BR proportions should accommodate the 100 inch couch and coffee table with a usable circulation path.
caveats: Chelsea/NoMad edge rather than deeper downtown.
listings.notes: Best fully verified 1BR today on unit quality, daylight confidence, must-haves, and commute.

listings.name: Avalon West Chelsea #001-613
listings.verificationNote: Price, size, and date verified on the opened Avalon inventory page; explicit washer/dryer, wall AC, dishwasher, and west exposure verified on the opened unit detail page.

commute.route: long walk to A/C/E or bus-plus-walk
commute.notes: Commute is still workable but materially weaker than the Chelsea/West Village leaders.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Unit detail page explicitly listed washer/dryer, wall AC, dishwasher, microwave, and west exposure; community page confirmed in-unit washer/dryer and modern kitchens.
listings.furnitureFit: 621 sq ft is just over the stricter 1BR fit bar and the dedicated floorplan makes the living room plausible for the sofa plus coffee table, but it is not notably generous.
caveats: West Chelsea commute is near the user’s comfort threshold.
Daylight is inferred from west exposure and modern tower layout rather than explicitly shown in room-dimension text.
listings.notes: Very credible 1BR but kept out of shortlist because the commute and daylight proof are weaker than Beatrice.

listings.name: Avalon West Chelsea #001-514
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened Avalon inventory page. Exact unit detail page did not open cleanly in this session, so price/date/size were verified but full unit-level amenity detail remained indirect.

commute.route: long walk to A/C/E or bus-plus-walk
commute.notes: Same West Chelsea commute tradeoff as #001-613.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Community page confirms in-unit washer/dryer and modern stainless steel kitchens, but the specific unit page was not retrievable for a full appliance-by-appliance confirmation.
listings.furnitureFit: 630 sq ft and a floorplan image make the layout plausible for the target living-room setup.
caveats: Unit detail page was inaccessible in-session.
Dishwasher, A/C, and window/daylight proof were not all confirmed on the specific unit page.
listings.notes: Strong June timing and price, but monitor-only because the final must-have proof remained incomplete.

listings.name: 777 6th Avenue 1BR (Unit F, floor 4)
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened Equity page: floor 4 1BR at $5,925 for 636 sq ft with photos, video, and 3D floorplan.

commute.route: R/W from 28 St to Prince or walk

amenities: Individually controlled heat and air conditioning
listings.mustHaveEvidence: The opened Equity page explicitly lists dishwasher, stainless steel appliances, floor-to-ceiling windows, and individually controlled heat and air conditioning.
listings.furnitureFit: 636 sq ft with a 3D floorplan looks workable for the sofa and coffee table.
caveats: No explicit laundry evidence was visible on the opened live page.
listings.notes: Strong apartment and commute, but unresolved laundry evidence keeps it out of shortlist.

listings.name: Eve East Village #2AS

commute.route: roughly a 25-30 minute walk or L-plus-walk
commute.notes: Commute works, but it is not as frictionless as the best Chelsea/West Village options.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: The opened floorplan page verified #2AS at 944 sq ft and $7,850 available now; the opened amenities page confirmed washer/dryer in every apartment, individually temperature controlled rooms, oversized windows, and natural light.
listings.furnitureFit: 944 sq ft and the floorplan clear the living-room fit bar for the sofa and coffee table.
caveats: Dishwasher was not explicitly confirmed on the opened live pages.
listings.notes: This would otherwise be the best current 2BR/2BA hit, but unresolved dishwasher evidence pushes it into monitor under the current stricter rules.

listings.name: The Chelsea B2-R
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened building inventory page. The current live page showed B2-R at $9,479+ and B3-R at $9,994+, not the cheaper stale unit surfaced in search.
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Live page clearly verified the current 2BR/2BA pricing, square footage, and availability count, but did not provide clean unit-level dishwasher/HVAC detail on the same inventory screen.
listings.furnitureFit: 948 sq ft is big enough for the target living room.
caveats: Current live pricing is above the user’s $9,000 2BR cap.
The live page did not provide complete same-screen unit-level appliance detail.
listings.notes: Still interesting as a budget stretch reference point, but not a shortlist candidate.

listings.name: Avalon Bowery Place #001-209
listings.verificationNote: Verified live on the opened Avalon inventory page.

commute.route: walk or very short N/R/W ride

listings.mustHaveEvidence: The opened inventory page verified 2BR/2BA, 1,104 sq ft, price, and timing. Broader community amenities were visible, but full unit-specific appliance detail was not all verified on the live inventory card.
listings.furnitureFit: 1,104 sq ft easily clears the living-room fit bar.
caveats: Availability is well after the desired June 1-7 window.
listings.notes: Included only as a location/quality reference; the budget miss is too large.

listings.name: 82 Jane Street #2C
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened Brodsky page verified the unit, price, and date plus building laundry facilities.
listings.furnitureFit: No usable floorplan or room dimensions were surfaced, so the living-room fit is unclear.
listings.notes: Good location and timing, but too many unresolved must-haves for shortlist.

listings.name: 28 Greenwich Avenue #5A
listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened Brodsky page verified the available unit, price, and date plus building laundry facilities.
listings.furnitureFit: West Village pre-war one-bedrooms at this price can work, but there was no floorplan or square-footage proof on the opened page.
listings.notes: Very strong neighborhood fit, but too conditional to shortlist.

listings.name: 50 Murray Street #929
listings.verificationNote: Opened StreetEasy unit page verified the listing is current, but it is 3BR/1BA and August timing.

commute.notes: Commute is excellent, but the apartment misses the core spec.

listings.mustHaveEvidence: Opened StreetEasy page explicitly showed central air, dishwasher, and laundry in building.
listings.furnitureFit: Likely fine on raw room count, but the lack of floorplan and the bathroom shortfall make it irrelevant for the target spec.
rejectionReasons: Track C target is true 3BR/3BA; this is only 3BR/1BA.
Availability is 8/4/2026, well after the June move target.
listings.notes: Current page, but not a viable match.

listings.name: The Chelsea B6-U stale search hit
listings.verificationNote: Search results surfaced B6-U at $8,000 and 1,166 sq ft, but the opened live inventory page no longer showed B6-U at all; current live units were B2-R and B3-R at higher prices.
rejectionReasons: Search-result stale or mismatched against the opened live page.
listings.notes: Excluded because the surfaced unit did not survive direct page opening.

listings.name: StuyTown unit 601-02F
listings.verificationNote: Opened unit page rendered incomplete placeholder-like detail and did not expose a reliable live price in this session.
rejectionReasons: Could not verify live price and complete listing details on the opened page.
listings.notes: StuyTown remains worth monitoring generally, but this specific opened page was not reliable enough to include as a live candidate.

listings.name: 151 West 17th Street #3C
listings.verificationNote: Opened page itself marked the listing as rented and showed an 'available on 8/1/2008' artifact, indicating a stale historical page rather than current inventory.
rejectionReasons: Opened page is stale and not current live inventory.
listings.notes: Classic false positive from search discovery.

listings.name: 2 River Terrace Unit 8-M
listings.neighborhood: Battery Park North / Tribeca West edge
listings.verificationNote: Exact-unit discovery result redirected to a generic New York apartments search page when opened.
rejectionReasons: Exact listing page could not be verified because the opened URL redirected away from the unit.
listings.notes: Excluded despite a promising search snippet because the actual page did not resolve to the unit.
